title: Chaalbaaz
desc: Anju endures mistreatment at home, whereas her long-separated twin Manju boldly navigates life's challenges. By some quirk of fate, they end up trading places, and their worlds erupt in chaos.

title: Hogi Pyar Ki Jeet
desc: Two brothers attempt to fulfil their dying father's wish by marrying two daughters of an old enemy, intending to exact revenge.

title: Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana
desc: Satyendra and Aarti meet for an arranged marriage and end up falling in love with each other. Their lives, however, change completely when she runs away on their wedding day.

title: Sapoot
desc: Devastated after the ruthless murder of their father, two brothers, Raj and Prem, set out to exact revenge on the gangster responsible for his death.

title: Indian
desc: Police officer Raj Azad arrests terrorist Wasim Khan and prepares to interrogate him. However, his father-in-law mysteriously dies, after which he is blamed for his death and goes on the run.
